title:

question:
How many green-skinned villains are there in the superhero universe?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: green-skinned refers to colour.colour = 'Green' WHERE skin_colour_id = colour.id; villains refers to alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_024 = c.XCL_005

  AND a.XCL_002 = 'Bad';
